# Accessibility Considerations Toolkit (ACT)

For toolkit work, follow
[the resource instructions](../../Accessibility-Considerations-Toolkit/AGENTS.md). Run toolkit
commands from `Accessibility-Considerations-Toolkit`, not the monorepo root. Use the
[consideration-to-schema skill](../skills/consideration-to-schema/SKILL.md) to generate YAML from
Markdown. These instructions do not apply to `Maximize-All-Windows`.
